note.en: Both sides reject a closing marker indented deeper than the opening one, keep the line as diagram content and auto-close the block at the end of the document.
note.zh: 两侧都会拒绝缩进比开标记更深的闭标记，将该行保留为图表内容，并在文档结束时自动闭合块。

note.en: Both sides require the closing marker line to contain only spaces after the marker, so the line stays in the diagram source and the block is auto-closed at the end of the document.
note.zh: 两侧都要求闭标记行中标记之后只能有空格，因此该行留在图表源码中，块在文档结束时自动闭合。

notes.en: `@mdit/plugin-uml` is the generalized base implementation of `markdown-it-plantuml`: it contains the same `@`-marker block rule, line scanning and auto-close rules, with the marker names, the token name and the renderer turned into options. This spec compares only that base block parser; the PlantUML image and encoder layer is out of scope and is disabled on both sides. The marker options are mapped 1:1 — the current side is configured with `{ name: "uml", open: "startuml", close: "enduml", renderer }` and the reference with `{ openMarker: "@startuml", closeMarker: "@enduml", generateSource, render }` — and each plugin registers its rule before `fence` with the same `alt` list, so the two parsers see the same block boundaries.
notes.zh: `@mdit/plugin-uml` 是 `markdown-it-plantuml` 的泛化基础实现：它包含相同的 `@` 标记块规则、行扫描与自动闭合规则，只是把标记名、token 名和渲染器变为选项。本规范只比较该基础块解析器；PlantUML 图片与编码器层不在范围内，且在两侧都被禁用。标记选项一一对应——当前包侧配置为 `{ name: "uml", open: "startuml", close: "enduml", renderer }`，参考包侧配置为 `{ openMarker: "@startuml", closeMarker: "@enduml", generateSource, render }`——两个插件都在 `fence` 之前注册各自规则并使用相同的 `alt` 列表，因此两个解析器看到的块边界一致。

notes.en: Rendering is replaced by a deterministic dump on both sides: `blocks=N` followed by the document HTML of the shared markdown-it renderer, with every plugin block token serialized as `block markup=… params=… title=… map=… content=…` (strings JSON-quoted). The output is compared byte for byte (`normalize` is the identity function), because the only real differences are inside that record and the surrounding HTML comes from the same markdown-it core. No encoder, server URL or network access is involved on either side: the current `renderer` option and the reference `render` option return the record, and the reference `generateSource` returns the diagram source unchanged instead of the deflate + base64 server URL.
notes.zh: 两侧都用确定性的转储代替渲染：先输出 `blocks=N`，再输出共享 markdown-it 渲染器的文档 HTML，每个插件块 token 序列化为 `block markup=… params=… title=… map=… content=…`（字符串用 JSON 引号包裹）。输出按字节比较（`normalize` 为恒等函数），因为真正的差异只存在于该记录内部，而外围 HTML 来自同一个 markdown-it 核心。两侧都不涉及编码器、服务器 URL 或网络访问：当前包的 `renderer` 选项与参考包的 `render` 选项都返回该记录，参考包的 `generateSource` 直接返回图表源码，而不是 deflate + base64 的服务器 URL。

notes.en: The reference never stores the diagram source on its token: the block rule passes it to `generateSource` and keeps the result in the `src` attribute, while `token.content` stays empty. The current base stores it in `token.content`. The identity `generateSource` is therefore both the replacement for the encoder and the way the reference's extracted source is read back for the record; the `src`/`alt` attributes and the `` tag are not compared (the current base pushes a placeholder `` token without attributes, and the image markup is the layer this spec excludes).
notes.zh: 参考包从不把图表源码存到 token 上：块规则将其传给 `generateSource`，并把结果保存在 `src` 属性中，而 `token.content` 保持为空。当前基础包则存入 `token.content`。因此恒等 `generateSource` 既替代了编码器，也是回读参考包提取出的源码以写入该记录的手段；`src`/`alt` 属性和 `` 标签不参与比较（当前基础包压入的是不带属性的占位 `` token，而图片标记属于本规范排除的层次）。

notes.en: The reference hard-codes the token type `uml_diagram`, which is also its renderer key. In the current package both are the `name` option (`uml` here, which is also the name `@mdit/plugin-plantuml` passes). The record prints a canonical `block` marker instead of the literal token type so that this naming difference does not mask the field-by-field comparison; the serializer of each side is installed as the renderer rule for its own token type, so a token of an unexpected type would not be rendered at all.
notes.zh: 参考包硬编码 token 类型 `uml_diagram`，它同时也是其渲染器键。当前包中两者都是 `name` 选项（此处为 `uml`，也是 `@mdit/plugin-plantuml` 传入的名字）。记录中打印规范的 `block` 标记而非字面 token 类型，以免这一命名差异掩盖逐字段比较；每侧的序列化器都安装为自己 token 类型的渲染器规则，因此类型不符的 token 根本不会被渲染。

notes.en: Titles are handled differently by the two implementations. The reference derives an `alt` inside the block rule: it drops the first character of the marker suffix (`params.slice(1)`, assuming a separating space) and inline-parses the rest into `token.children`, falling back to the fixed `uml diagram` when the suffix is empty. The current base derives nothing: it exposes the raw suffix as `token.info` and leaves titles to the renderer (`@mdit/plugin-plantuml` uses that raw suffix as the image alt text). The compared `title` field is therefore the raw `info` on the current side and the inline-rendered alt text on the reference side; the fixed `uml diagram` fallback is not compared because it is an arbitrary label of the disabled image layer (the `plugin-plantuml` comparison covers it). `title`, `title-inline-markup`, `title-only-space` and `odd-marker-suffix` document the remaining differences.
notes.zh: 两种实现对标题的处理不同。参考包在块规则内生成 `alt`：去掉标记后缀的第一个字符（`params.slice(1)`，假定存在分隔空格），将剩余部分行内解析到 `token.children`，后缀为空时回退为固定的 `uml diagram`。当前基础包不做任何推导：它把原始后缀暴露为 `token.info`，把标题留给渲染器（`@mdit/plugin-plantuml` 就用该原始后缀作为图片 alt 文本）。因此参与比较的 `title` 字段在当前包侧是原始 `info`，在参考包侧是行内渲染后的 alt 文本；固定的 `uml diagram` 回退值不参与比较，因为它属于被禁用的图片层的任意标签（由 `plugin-plantuml` 的比较覆盖）。`title`、`title-inline-markup`、`title-only-space` 和 `odd-marker-suffix` 记录了其余差异。

notes.en: The body is extracted differently: the current package calls `state.getLines(startLine + 1, nextLine, state.blkIndent, false)` and `dedent`, while the reference slices the raw document with `state.src.split('\n').slice(startLine + 1, nextLine).join('\n')`. Both agree on the line range, the auto-close rules, the block count, the `markup` and the token `map` in every case; they disagree on the text. The reference keeps the indentation of list items and of indented blocks and even the `>` prefixes of blockquotes, while the current package strips the container prefixes and the common indentation. `list-item`, `list-item-unclosed`, `blockquote`, `nested-blockquote`, `indented-marker` and `indented-content` document this; the block structure around the diagrams is identical in all of them.
notes.zh: 正文提取方式不同：当前包调用 `state.getLines(startLine + 1, nextLine, state.blkIndent, false)` 和 `dedent`，参考包则用 `state.src.split('\n').slice(startLine + 1, nextLine).join('\n')` 切分原始文档。所有用例中，两者对行范围、自动闭合规则、块数量、`markup` 和 token `map` 的判断一致，但文本内容不同。参考包保留列表项和缩进块的缩进，甚至保留块引用的 `>` 前缀，而当前包会去掉容器前缀和公共缩进。`list-item`、`list-item-unclosed`、`blockquote`、`nested-blockquote`、`indented-marker` 和 `indented-content` 记录了这一点；这些用例中图表周围的块结构完全相同。

notes.en: Both sides reject a closing marker that is indented deeper than the opening one or followed by non-space text, keep that line as diagram content and auto-close the block at the end of the parent; `closing-marker-indented` and `closing-marker-trailing-text` pin this down. Markers inside fences and indented code blocks are not parsed by either side (both rules sit between `code` and `fence`), and an escaped (`\@startuml`) or mid-line marker stays paragraph text on both sides.
notes.zh: 两侧都会拒绝缩进比开标记更深或后接非空白文本的闭标记，将其保留为图表内容，并在父级结束时自动闭合块；`closing-marker-indented` 和 `closing-marker-trailing-text` 固定了这一行为。围栏代码块和缩进代码块内的标记两侧都不解析（两个规则都位于 `code` 与 `fence` 之间），转义（`\@startuml`）或位于行中的标记在两侧都保持为段落文本。

notes.en: Benchmarks use the same deterministic dump, so they measure block parsing and the shared markdown-it rendering only; the deflate + base64 encoder and the network are excluded on both sides. The `heavy` corpora contain four diagrams per section rather than one, so their ratios also include the reference's per-block whole-document split described below.
notes.zh: 基准测试使用相同的确定性转储，因此只测量块解析和共享的 markdown-it 渲染；deflate + base64 编码器与网络在两侧都被排除。`heavy` 语料每个小节包含四个图表而不是一个，因此其比值还包含下文所述参考包按块切分整个文档的开销。

notes.en: Scaling: the reference extracts every block with `state.src.split('\n')`, so each block costs O(document) and many blocks cost O(blocks × document) — quadratic. `many-blocks` and `unmatched-openers` (every list item opens a block that is auto-closed by the next item) target that; `long-block-body` is linear on both sides and serves as the baseline. The current package slices only the block lines with `state.getLines` and stays linear in the number of blocks; no superlinear path was found in it.
notes.zh: 扩展性：参考包用 `state.src.split('\n')` 提取每个块，因此单个块的成本为 O(document)，块很多时为 O(blocks × document)——即二次。`many-blocks` 和 `unmatched-openers`（每个列表项都开启一个块，并由下一项自动闭合）针对这一点；`long-block-body` 在两侧都是线性的，作为基线。当前包只用 `state.getLines` 切出块所在行，在块数量上保持线性；未在其内部发现超线性路径。
